### Borea v0.7.1

A patch release for a second start of a running instance. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixed

- When Borea closed itself for the game and you opened it again while the game still ran, Borea did not know that the instance was running. You could start the same instance a second time, and both games then used the same saves and settings. Borea now remembers the games it started, also after it closed, refuses a second start with "This instance is already running. Close the game first.", and keeps mod changes away from the running instance. Thanks to Onyx for the report.

Full changelog: [v0.7.0...v0.7.1](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1)
